note: One record per licence agreement that governs pictures this app may show. It is the agreement itself, as data: who granted it, the notice and the credit line it requires, what it covers, and the dates that decide whether it is in force. `executed_on` and `samples_approved_on` are null until the owner has the executed agreement AND the licensor's written approval of the samples in hand; while either is null, `pipeline species-media ingest-licensed` refuses every media record that names the agreement, so those records stay `pending`. NOAA's agreement was executed on 2026-10-01 and its samples approved on 2026-09-30, so both are set on that record. See docs/species-media-contract.md section 17 and docs/legal/licence-agreements/README.md.
